summary_zh: 已定位全部17条插件 WaitOnAddress 栈：1条WGL窗口关闭通知接收，16条Rayon空闲工作线程条件变量等待；没有证据将它们归为CUDA参数槽或manager锁死。官方.73匹配PDB未在现有可访问位置找到。源码核查确认Render内宿主参数读写、Rc跨线程引用计数、同一实例可变别名/重入和擦除类型析构问题；尚未证实其中哪项导致本次宿主空指针异常。

symbols.name: gyroflow_ofx.pdb
symbols.scope: No matching PDB found in the two repository target trees, published artifact or original CI cache. This does not prove no archival copy exists elsewhere.
symbols.reference_pdb_policy: A separate local release DLL was opened with its own matching PDB for independent comparison. Its PDB was not loaded or forced into the official .73 dump.

wait_on_address.caller: wgpu-hal 29.0.3 gles::wgl hidden-window owner thread -> std sync mpsc receiver -> WaitOnAddress
wait_on_address.purpose_zh: 等待drop_rx关闭通知以释放隐藏窗口和设备上下文
wait_on_address.confidence: identified from exact dependency version, dump thread name and unique blocking receive in that thread
wait_on_address.not_evidence_of: CUDA kernel/event completion wait or native fallback

wait_on_address.proof: Official .73 disassembly passes a Rust panic Location for this unwrap; decoded from PE at RVA0x15AEAE8, it contains the exact crate path and line187. All16 stacks share the same wait and worker-loop chain.
wait_on_address.meaning_zh: 线程池等待新任务/唤醒；不能把这些栈解释成stabilization写锁或CUDA参数槽等待
wait_on_address.caveat: An idle-wait classification of these stacks does not prove the entire process could never deadlock at another time.

static_ofx: cache_keyframes: reads host values then swaps owned cached keyframe map under RwLock
process_pixels recomputes invalidated smoothness/zoom/undistortion then enters native CUDA
call_chain.dynamic_gap: The exception GUI stack has no active Gyroflow/ofx plugin frame. The last cache_keyframes log is16:09:12UTC; crash is16:09:31UTC. It is not established whether the fatal mousePress event entered the OFX parameter callback before the exception.
call_chain.locking: Normal repeated Smoothness edits do not synchronously run smoothing or wait for CUDA in the callback. cache_keyframes holds no kparams write guard during host queries; the replacement is protected by its own RwLock. Core invalidation methods do not acquire the native stabilization write lock despite their names.
call_chain.cache_lifetime: clear_stab is gated by !ever_changed for ordinary parameter edits. A Render-local Arc<StabilizationManager> retains the old manager. The custom keyframe provider owns Arc<RwLock<KeyframableParams>>, not raw OFX ParamHandles. These paths do not establish direct UAF from simply clearing the manager cache.

findings.title_zh: Render回调内调用宿主当前值读写API，和UI状态写入可交错
findings.detail_zh: 平滑度回调写Status=calculating和Status=ok。Render在update_synchronization_status -> set_status中调用get_string(Status)，必要时set_string(Status)、set_hint，并调用update_loaded_state。update_loaded_state遍历控件enabled属性并再次写Status和OpenGyroflow标签。Resolve的set_string最终使用paramSetValue，get_string使用paramGetValue。OFX参数suite要求paramGetValue不用于Render、Render读取用AtTime；paramSetValue限于InstanceChanged或interact。
specific_interleaving: Render读到该状态并认为需要恢复ok
Render调用宿主paramSetValue/属性更新，同时UI处理valueChanged或参数状态变化
findings.guard_caveat: enabled setter会跳过同值；不能声称每次拖动都实际写入OutputHeight.enabled。Status/hint/label写入是另外的调用。
findings.regression: The equivalent Render status update exists inline in .60; .73 extracts a helper. This is an existing contract issue, not proved to be newly introduced by native CUDA.

findings.title_zh: OFX绑定没有线程安全与递归回调边界
findings.detail_zh: 全局Registry经static mut取得&mut；每次action dispatch克隆Suites，其中多张suite表由std::rc::Rc管理。跨线程clone/drop同一Rc产生非原子引用计数竞态，独立的UI/render实例也不能隔离这个插件全局共享状态。get_instance_data又从同一裸指针直接生成&mut InstanceData；普通LRU/managers和缓存字段没有实例级同步，而描述符宣称FullySafe。平滑度处理期间仍持有这些可变借用并调用宿主paramSetValue，宿主若同步递归InstanceChanged会再次取得同一实例的可变引用。
findings.not_infinite_recursion: 手动标记与Status的PluginEdited分支不会重新执行Smoothness UserEdited业务；未发现单纯由此形成无限逻辑递归。问题是递归期间的可变别名和宿主并发访问。
findings.fix_constraint: 不能只给整个action入口套普通不可重入Mutex；OFX明确允许这些递归回调，会带来新的自等待。这里只记录约束，没有修改代码。
findings.regression: The pinned ofx-rs revision, FullySafe declaration and manual-edit setter are already present in .60. Native-CUDA scheduling exposure is a hypothesis with unknown frequency, not a confirmed regression mechanism.

findings.title_zh: 实例销毁擦除了真实析构类型
findings.detail_zh: set_instance_data以Box<T>保存原始指针；drop_instance_data从VoidPtrMut取回后直接Box::from_raw(ptr)，此处类型是Box<c_void>，没有调用InstanceData的真实析构器，也未清空宿主数据指针。成员释放与分配布局不满足原有Box<T>所有权契约。
findings.scope_zh: 这是同一旧版绑定的生命周期缺陷；现有转储没有将DestroyInstance或销毁后访问连接到本次valueChanged崩溃，不能把它当作已确认触发点。

facts: Fault instruction reads RCX=0 inside Resolve.exe+0xE6BEF0.
The surrounding routine decrements a reference count, conditionally releases values, and traverses child pointers. It resembles container/value cleanup; exact C++ type and function name are unknown.
The captured heap bytes near RBX contain ASCII OutputHeight. This is a clue tying the state to a parameter name, not proof that update_loaded_state or OutputHeight.enabled wrote it.

The field visible in the later captured heap is nonzero; exception registers and dump memory alone cannot determine which earlier writer, cleanup or corruption caused the null seen by the faulting instruction.
fault_lifetime_evidence.inference_zh: 应优先查宿主参数状态清理/回调重入与跨线程参数写入的交界；现有证据不足以区分提前释放、对象重入清理、先前内存破坏或宿主自身缺陷。

baseline.render_status_update_change: .60 inline versus .73 helper; not new behavior

next_actions_ranked.action_zh: 在独立.73实例用兼容x64调试器记录action、线程ID、实例地址和回调嵌套，并在宿主paramSetValue入口区分Render与InstanceChanged调用，重点核实Status交错。无需先改产品代码。
若要做诊断构建，先做单变量对照：仅停止Render中的宿主状态/标签写入，保持CUDA开关与算法不变。该项涉及代码，当前没有实施。
依据回调记录设计绑定层线程/重入/析构修复；不要仅凭这些旧缺陷将原生CUDA同步策略改成全局等待或全局action锁。

remaining_unknowns: Original .73 PDB not recovered; Resolve private symbols unavailable.
Exact host function/class owning the cleanup node and the first state-corrupting operation are unknown.
No runtime record yet proves simultaneous access to the same InstanceData in Resolve, nor the fatal event's precise OFX callback nesting.
No new reproduction, first-chance capture or diagnostic-build comparison was run in this analysis-only turn.
